timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Ransomware plan. Stop them from getting in, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Wrong order. Recovery comes first. Hardening second.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: If you can't restore, attackers win even when prevention fails. Immutable backups change the math.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What do we back up first?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Identity systems. Then human life, financial, product enablement, security monitoring.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Limit the blast radius. Protect privileged access, stop lateral movement, isolate infected devices fast.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Randomize local admin passwords, isolate service accounts, secure privileged accounts with MFA.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Make entry hard. Email security, endpoint protection, MFA, secure remote access, patching.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Not last, but never at the expense of phases one and two. Recovery readiness wins.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How often do we test recovery?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Regularly. An untested restore is just a hope.
